title: Work at the Frontier: AI’s effect on freelance work
summary: New research from OpenAI and Upwork finds shifting demand for freelance work, new skill combinations, and larger budgets and more hours for AI-related projects.
reason: OpenAI/Upwork report on labor-market data: shifting freelance demand, new skill combinations, larger budgets and more hours for AI-related projects. Reports market data, not a model release; links to the official OpenAI announcement page.
